page.overview:
What is Yakuza?

Yakuza was an organization. The Anzellan gambling hall owner Que-Dama was a Yakuza leader.

The Yakuza leader Que-Dama first appeared in "The Duel: Payback", a non-canon short film directed by Takanobu Mizuno released as part of the third volume of the Star Wars: Visions series. The animated short, produced by Kamikaze Douga and ANIMA, was released on Disney+ on October 29, 2025. The organization was first mentioned in a production brief document for Star Wars: Visions Volume 3, published on October 24, 2025.
